trigger: Executing npm run lint across .agents and build directories
preconditions: Presence of raw agent prompt regexes or build outputs
reproduction_steps: 1. Run npx eslint . without .agents exclusion. 2. Observe parser choking on markdown/skill regex tokens.
expected_result: ESLint exits code 0 with calibrated warnings and ignored non-runtime agent assets.
actual_result: ESLint now cleanly ignores .agents/** and .output/**, exiting code 0 with 0 errors and 178 warnings.
proximate_cause: Unescaped regex patterns in agent skill instructions scanned by JS parser.
root_cause: Overly broad glob include pattern in initial flat eslint configuration.
contributing_factors: Introduction of .agents directory without updating eslint ignore array.
why_missed: Pre-commit hook only checked src/ directory while root lint scanned everything.
blast_radius: CI/CD static analysis gating; blocked clean gate verification.
user_impact: None directly in browser runtime; developer tooling friction.
operational_impact: Blocked automated deployment pipelines on false positive lint errors.
remediation: Ignore non-code assets and restrict TypeScript parsing to valid source trees.
regression_test: npm run lint in CI pipeline

trigger: Work Pulse component attempting to author authoritative state independent of canonical event store

actual_result: Enforced: Work Pulse subscribes to canonical event gateway and never writes authoritative state directly.
proximate_cause: Potential architectural anti-pattern where UI stream becomes secondary source of truth.
root_cause: Temptation to optimize UI responsiveness by storing authoritative data in client-side state.
why_missed: Architectural risk detected during preemptive code audit.
blast_radius: Catastrophic; could cause state divergence between UI and backend database.
user_impact: User could see actions reported as successful that never persisted to the central ledger.
security_impact: Ultra High; unauthorized client-authoritative state changes.
logs: WorkPulseSourceOfTruth: Read-only projection verified against canonical event store
containment: Make Work Pulse store read-only with unidirectional data flow from event gateway.
remediation: Enforced projection-only architecture: Work Pulse consumes from EventIngestionGateway.

trigger: Multiple external identities sharing similar names, handles, or emails across different tenant boundaries
preconditions: User in Tenant A connects GitHub account; User in Tenant B has matching GitHub username
reproduction_steps: 1. Attempt cross-tenant link using unpartitioned handle lookup. 2. Verify tenant partition check.
expected_result: Identity correlation keys must strictly incorporate tenant_id: {tenant_id}:{provider}:{external_id}.
actual_result: Enforced: Compound primary keys include tenant_id. Cross-tenant linkage attempts return partition violation error.
proximate_cause: Potential naive lookup on external handle alone without tenant scoping.
root_cause: Global namespace assumption in multi-tenant data architecture.
contributing_factors: External platforms (GitHub, v0) have global single-tenant namespaces.
why_missed: Identified during STRIDE threat model (P19 IDOR audit).
blast_radius: Ultra High; cross-tenant data leakage, repository exposure, unauthorized code access.
user_impact: Guarantees complete isolation between organizations and enterprise workspaces.
security_impact: Ultra High; eliminates IDOR and confused-deputy attacks.
data_integrity_impact: Ultra High; prevents repository lineage corruption.
operational_impact: Mandatory compliance requirement for SOC2 and ISO 27001.
logs: identityGraph: Tenant partition validation passed (tenant_id mandatory in all correlation keys)
containment: Reject any correlation call missing verified tenant_id context.
remediation: All identity lookups require composite key `${tenantId}:${provider}:${externalId}`.

trigger: Missed webhook event or network disruption leaving local state stale relative to upstream GitHub repository
preconditions: Webhook gateway experiences temporary network drop during commit push
reproduction_steps: 1. Simulate dropped push event. 2. Trigger periodic reconciliation. 3. Verify watermark convergence.
expected_result: Deterministic snapshot reconciliation compares watermarks and backfills missing events.
actual_result: Enforced: Dual event-driven + scheduled snapshot reconciliation recovers missing state and updates watermarks.
proximate_cause: Relying exclusively on webhooks without polling/reconciliation fallback.
root_cause: Assuming 100% reliable event delivery over public internet webhooks.
contributing_factors: Webhook delivery failure rates in distributed networks (0.1 - 1%).
why_missed: Happy-path testing always delivers webhooks reliably.
blast_radius: High; stale branch status, missed pull request reviews, out-of-date security vulnerability alerts.
user_impact: User could see stale repository health indicators.
security_impact: Medium; delayed detection of newly pushed security issues.
data_integrity_impact: High; event stream must eventually converge with ground truth.
operational_impact: Prevents drift between GitHub truth and VYRON control plane.
containment: Flag state as STALE if reconciliation age exceeds freshness SLA threshold (15 minutes).
remediation: Implemented cursor-based snapshot backfill with deterministic conflict resolution.

trigger: Submitting a SHA-256 hash without accompanying raw input, execution environment, and timestamp context

root_cause: Superficial implementation of cryptographic audit trails.
contributing_factors: Storage optimization attempting to avoid storing input payloads.
why_missed: Hash validation tests only checked string length (64 chars) without verifying preimage reproducibility.
blast_radius: High; audit reports unverifiable by independent third parties.
user_impact: Compliance audits fail because evidence cannot be deterministically re-evaluated.

data_integrity_impact: High; core premise of evidence-governed control plane violated.
operational_impact: Guarantees evidentiary validity for compliance and legal discovery.

containment: Reject evidence registration if preimage or generator version is absent.

trigger: Page mount reading saved registration draft or password strength
preconditions: User opens registration page with previously cached localStorage draft
expected_result: Initial state populated directly in useState lazy initializer rather than synchronous setState in effect.
actual_result: State updated synchronously inside useEffect; causes single cascading re-render on initial mount.
proximate_cause: Calling setState inside useEffect body for initial draft restoration.
root_cause: Legacy React 16/17 idiom used in draft restoration logic.
contributing_factors: React 19 compiler stricter analysis of cascading render effects.
why_missed: Behavior is functional and does not produce visible flicker or user error.
blast_radius: Localized to /register and /reset-password initial mount cycle.
user_impact: Negligible (<2ms extra render time during page load).
operational_impact: Adds diagnostic warning in build logs.
containment: Calibrated warning acknowledged; does not block production build or user interaction.
remediation: Refactor draft restoration to useState(() => loadSavedDraft()) lazy initializer pattern.

preconditions: Multiple copilot sessions active in same browser window

contributing_factors: Copilot Studio message stream stability requirements.
why_missed: Functional test passes because session state is read via store getter.
blast_radius: Localized to Copilot session dispatch handler.
user_impact: None observed; messages route to active session correctly.
logs: ESLint: warning React Hook useCallback has a missing dependency: 'currentSession'
containment: Calibrated warning; session reference is verified via store selector.
remediation: Replace with currentSessionRef or add functional updater to satisfy hook linter.
